Re #1977 (audit: existing provenance bridge for the five q/t1 hrows). Independently verified against source — confirms your own #1979 re-check, no discrepancy.

Checked what's actually in scope at the live tail call site (`U1LargeCapRouteBTail.lean:37-140`, up through `Hdepth5Rows`/`hfixed`):
- `U3FixedTriplePacket` (`U3ToU5DangerousTriple.lean:32`) only supplies p-centered facts: `t1_same_radius`/`t2_same_radius`/`t3_same_radius` are all `dist p t_i = dist p q`. No q-centered or t1-centered equality anywhere in its field list.
- `hbaseDistinct`/`hbaseSixPairwise` are pairwise-distinctness only, not metric equalities.
- `Hdepth5Rows : CriticalSourceRows D q t1 t2 t3 u` (`U1Depth5Prefix.lean:513`) bundles one `CriticalRowPacket` per source (q, t1, t2, t3, u), but each `CriticalRowPacket` (`U1Depth5Prefix.lean:433`) is generic: its 4 "selected" slot members are an arbitrary `CriticalSelectedFourClass`, with only `source_eq_named` (the source equals one of its own 4 members) as a structural guarantee. Nothing forces e.g. `t1`/`t2`/`u` to occupy specific slots of `qRow`, or `p`/`q`/`t3`/`u` to occupy specific slots of `t1Row` — that's exactly the "placement" data (`hfix_*`/`hpt_*`) that has to be supplied separately and isn't established anywhere upstream.
- `PacketLabelCenteredRows.ofGlobalK4` (already flagged dead in #1919/#1924) likewise only gives arbitrary K4 slots.

So: no, there is no existing named provenance bridge that derives `hrow_q_t1_f1`, `hrow_q_t2_f1`, `hrow_t1_p_f1`, `hrow_t1_q_f1`, `hrow_t1_t3_f1` from live tail data without new placement/provenance assumptions — the gap is structural (generic row-packet slots vs. specific live points), not just a missing lemma name. This is the same fundamental gap as the original 12-hrow audit (#1881), now confirmed to survive even with B/E removed from the consumer. No patch to land; agrees with your negative-ledger call.
